1.early: The Rat's carefree style and willingness to test the boundaries of their environment fit in perfect with childhood.  These are thus likely to be happy and exciting times for you. Your likely propensity to take risks shouldn't get you into too much trouble, as your responsibilities are not that great at this stage of life.
1.middle: You could find your middle years to be trying times. Life is not a game any more as it was in childhood. It is likely that you will experience some failures due to the relatively frequent risks you take. If you're an entrepreneur, bankruptcy is a definite possibility. A failed love affair is also more than a little likely.
1.late: In the end things usually turn out well for Rat-sign people. At least one of your schemes for making money should bear fruit and result in a comfortable life. Peace and happiness are yours if, during the years, you learn how to harness and channel your restless, mental activity into pursuits that bring you pleasure and relaxation.

2.early: Generally Ox-sign people do not go out of their way to stir up trouble for other people. Your early years are thus likely to be relatively unremarkable. Your happiness will depend mostly on your environment. You probably don't require a lot of emotional support, so if you receive just a little love and affection from your family you can be happy.
2.middle: During your middle years, however, your life, especially your love life, could become more problematic. The Ox-lady, for example, is the lady most likely to choose the wrong guy. And the Ox-man is the most most likely to devote himself to work at the expense of family. In fact you could have trouble with interpersonal relations in general.
2.late: Ox is a strong sign, and you're thus likely to have plenty of inner fortitude. Fate unfortunately works in such a way to give many challenges to test it. The tendency for the Ox, and probably you, is to shoulder others' burdens and to accumulate them throughout life. Your old age could be peaceful if you haven't overdone it.

3.early: Childhood was made for the Tiger. You should thus have many fun and exciting times in your youth. Depending on how strongly you exhibit the Tiger's love of independence and hotheadedness will determine how many conflicts with authority you might have. Overall, however, this time is likely to be relatively calm.
3.middle: The middle years will probably be your most turbulent time. Your passion and intensity are likely to cause problems in your marriage and with your finances.  There will also be surprise successes as you charge ahead in pursuit of your goals.  Regardless how it goes you won't lack for excitement.
3.late: There may be times you wonder if you will even make it to the later years. Chances are they will be much more peaceful than the preceding ones. Just how much will depend on how many and deep are your scars and how successfully you have resolved the conflicts in which you found yourself embroiled.

4.early: The Rabbit seeks peace above all else, so your early years should be peaceful. This depends, of course, on the quality of your family life. If there is a lot of turmoil, you could be off to a rough start. One thing is certain, you won't be the cause of it.
4.middle: More than your peers you are likely to try to fit in, be it in the classroom or the office. As with your youth, you will experience a lot of peace, by design. As you grow older you will become more adept at avoiding unpleasantly. Life will be as smooth as your efforts at this are effective.
4.late: Your later years have the potential to be the most calm, as you no longer have to face the stresses associated with striving for success in school and career. If you are fortunate enough to avoid health issues, this will be a peaceful and, probably, satisfying time.

5.early: Big dreams and grand ambitions, the Dragon's great strengths could cause you difficulties in your youth. You probably have a tendency to hold your parents and other authority figures up to a standard impossible for them to achieve and maintain. If so, you could suffer disappointments and become engaged in clashes of will.
5.middle: In your middle years you are likely to discover your goals are not so easy to achieve as you might previously have thought. Your family and friends, moreover, may not appreciate them nor support you to the extent you had hoped. This is especially true if you act superior to them or show signs of the flaky-artist behavior. Still, this could be an exhilarating time as you strive for some very high goals.
5.late: Your life is likely to be characterized by extremes. It is in your later years when the full impact hits. If you've been able to take advantage of your successes, you will have an extremely satisfying old age. Otherwise, you could find yourself thinking about what might have been and letting regrets occupy your thoughts.

6.early: As a Snake-sign person, a lot of your action and turbulence is internal. Add to this, during childhood, you are more likely to be soaking up knowledge than stirring up trouble. These factors could make your early years relatively peaceful.  You may beginning to show signs of ambition, but it's too early to experience real disappointment.
6.middle: By your middle years you are likely to be acquiring a variety of interesting, if not unusual, experiences. This stage of life can thus also be satisfying like the previous one. You are, nevertheless, susceptible to extremes, good and bad. If you are not impatient when it comes to improving yourself, this will probably be a memorable time.
6.late: It is in old age when you feel the full impact of life's vicissitudes. You are likely to share the Snake's insatiable drive to improve and experience new adventures. Your ability to perform, however, may not be at the required level, and you could fall short..Still, you may enjoy marvelous highs thanks to your intellectual pursuits.

7.early: Youth is a time of exploring the world and testing limits, activities which fit in nicely with Horse desires. Unfortunately those activities could also bring out the worst in you. This stage is likely to be full of exciting ups and downs.  You may sometimes find it difficult to concentrate in school and think about leaving home.
7.middle: Your middle years could be a turbulent time, full of travel and adventure. The Horse is not that lucky when it comes to romance. Your love life is not likely to be smooth but, rather, characterized by disappointments. Part of that may be your fault if you have the typical, Horse tendency to constantly seek greener pastures.
7.late: It is in the time of retirement, when you put yourself out to pasture, that you are most likely to achieve peace. You will, nevertheless, probably be more active than your peers. Fortunately for you Horse-sign people tend to retain their looks and their energy level longer than most other people. You'll even prefer the company of younger friends.

8.early: As this is a time to focus on self and to engage the imagination. It's likely to be a satisfying and rewarding, even lucky, time for you. As you enter your teens, however, you may find yourself having a constant stream of problems when it comes to romance. Although they are likely to be minor ones, they could wreak havoc with your emotions.
8.middle: These could be your most difficult years. Again, it is likely to be your love life that is the culprit. Your happiness will probably depend on marrying the right person and at the right time. This correlates with when and how well you complete your maturation process. You may well find yourself on and off an emotional roller coaster.
8.late: It is in old age when you are likely to feel most at peace, perhaps because you have gained control of your emotions. Luck is also likely to be with you. By now your love life has probably settled down, and you are with that special someone who brings you happiness. If that relationship holds, your final years will be wonderful.

9.early: As a Monkey-sign person you probably enjoy games and fun in general. Childhood is thus made for you, and it is likely to be your happiest time. The Monkey is often naive in youth and thus vulnerable to others taking advantage of them. You could, therefore, suffer some betrayals and disappointments in your teens and early twenties.
9.middle: Life could become very confusing in your middle years. As the Monkey often likes to play tricks on others, fate has a tendency to do the same to you. More than one of your plans are likely to fail or at least result in totally unexpected consequences. You will need to make good use of your wits to achieve success.
9.late: As you enter your later years you may find life is becoming much calmer. It's important for you to develop a lot of interests and have one or two people on whom you can really depend. Unfortunately all too often Monkey-sign people experience loneliness as they progress through old age.

10.early: The plucky Rooster, almost from the beginning, livens up its environment. People know when you are around. You're thus likely to make your mark on the world at an early age. Along with successes, however, come strained interpersonal relations, setbacks, and a generally turbulent time, especially when you discover the opposite sex.
10.middle: You are likely to experience the heights and depths of emotion in both your love and professional lives. Romantic entanglements from your earlier years could continue and complicate this time as well. At work you may be greatly appreciated for your organizational ability but, at the same time, disliked for your blunt approach.
10.late: Maybe you are wearing down from all that previous activity, or it's just the way of things. At any rate your later years are likely to be your most peaceful and satisfying. It is at this time that all your hard work will bring you joy. You also get along much better with other people now, which will bring you a lot of happiness.

11.early: Life often turns out all right, but Dog-sign people tend to be pessimists and don't see it that way. Thus, even though your childhood may be happy, you are still likely to experience anxiety as you begin to learn about the world around you. Uncertainty, rather than the joy of discovery, is likely to characterize your mood.
11.middle: Often the Dog has a penchant for nostalgia. If you too often look back longingly on the good old days of the past, you could become vulnerable to a mid-life crisis. As you think about your job and family, you may wonder whether all is really going well. Fortunately this uncertainty is more a matter of perception than reality.
11.late: Although you have made it this far and recorded more than a few accomplishments, uncertainly is still likely to remain with you. Again, this is more a function of your habit of looking back favorably at the past. You would be wise to consider the fact that, back then, you were also uncertain and didn't think things were going all that well.

12.early: Your early years are likely to be relatively calm. In fact your very earliest ones could be exceptionally happy. The Pig is the most tactile of the twelve signs, and it is through touch, physical contact, that a baby explores the world. You are also likely to be happy with all the opportunities for play at this time of your life.
12.middle: Of the twelve signs, the Pig is likely to be the most naive. This, very probably, will get you into difficulties, particularly in your love life.  Your family, as well as your professional life,  could thus be challenging. Your trusting nature and basic honesty will be appreciated but, nevertheless, might get you into trouble.
12.late: Among your peers you are probably the one to first look forward to Retirement. It's a time made for the Pig, the last of the twelve signs. Unless your life has been a total disaster, this should be a relaxing and peaceful time. It's time to reap the rewards for all the positive karma you have acquired in your life.
